svg.aria-label: IDSLab overview. Question: does every stage of your IDS cascade earn its place? 1 Your design: a binary classifier, a router and an anomaly gate, each with its model and decision, routed to BENIGN or ATTACK, written in one YAML file. 2 One fixed protocol: splits per seed with TEST locked, each stage fitted on its own rows, models and thresholds chosen on VAL with off as an option, TEST read once next to controls. 3 The answer on synthetic data: the cascade and the first stage alone reach almost the same TEST accuracy; the entry classifier carries the result and the router and gate add nothing here.
